sources.title: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B - Bonsai - docs.prismml.com
sources.snippet: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B is the largest multimodal model in the family: it accepts vision input alongside text. It is based on Qwen3.8 27B, a hybrid-attention causal language model, and its matrix weights are ternary — values in {−1, 0, +1} in a fixed rotated basis, with FP16 group scales.

sources.snippet: Bonsai 27B is the largest multimodal model in the family: it accepts vision input alongside text. It is based on Qwen3.6 27B. Like every Bonsai, the language model is quantized end-to-end 1-bit or ternary weights across embeddings, attention, MLPs, and the LM head. The vision tower is handled separately, at 4-bit.
